acceptance: Dead loaders removed or library loaders delegate to adapter load_data.
Generated files are byte-identical (or row-identical) to current output.
description: Not on the CLI path (which uses adapter load_data), but public API: benchmark-level load_data_to_database/_load_table_data use csv.reader plus per-row execute/executemany in core/benchmark_mixins.py:68-95, simple_benchmark_mixin.py:163-182 (SSB, AMPLab, ClickBench), tpcds/benchmark/runner.py:555-591 (possibly dead), tsbs_devops/benchmark.py:234-241, coffeeshop/benchmark.py:240-247, tpcdi/benchmark.py:447-478, tpcdi/loader.py:103,306. Data generation: core/primitives/generator_base.py:168-174,459-519 re-reads up to 1M lineitem rows with csv.reader and rewrites with join; SSB/AMPLab/TSBS/TPC-DI generators write one csv.writer row at a time. Route library loaders through adapter load_data or remove dead ones; use pyarrow.csv or DuckDB COPY in generation.
